title: The B58 identity certificate: commit A of build step 2 against cf43fbb
what: Commit A of build step 2 (decision 24; docs/build_step_2/PLAN.md, WP1, as AMENDMENTS.md amends it) threads each engine's own fuel, lambda clip, cycle form and intake cam through the plant, and registers the three EPA engines and their cars, typed and not calibrated. Before it lands on GRA-test, the B58 built through it has to be X1's plant, the plant of cf43fbb: the same doubles, not the same figures to a tolerance. This page says how that was measured and what came out. results/B58_IDENTITY.json holds every number below, read by make_cert.py from the run groups' records and the runs' own output files; the tools, the plan of the run and the evidence are archived beside it (section 7).
